 Job description
 The Department of Philosophy at the University of Arizona invites applications for a full-time faculty position in metaphysics or epistemology in the analytic tradition, broadly construed. The position may be filled at the rank of tenure-track Assistant Professor, or tenured Associate Professor, with an anticipated start date of August 1, 2027.
